corrupted.name: Corrupted
corrupted.blurb: Glitches, colours splitting apart, flickers — and a name that scrambles now and then.

fake.name: Fake Rarity
fake.blurb: It passes for a Mythic, but its true colours show at the edges.

inverted.name: Inverted
inverted.blurb: Its colours turned inside out, like a photo negative.

mirror.name: Mirror
mirror.blurb: Seen from the other side of the glass: the picture flipped, the name written backwards.

timelost.name: Time-Lost
timelost.blurb: Lost in time: now and then it slips into another face of its world, then comes back.

void.name: Void-Touched
void.blurb: Swallowed by the dark: only a small light shows it, wandering — or under your mouse.
